items.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022
items.q: Do I really want to hear a whole festival of just twenty-somethings and maybe one like a Joshua Redman.

ctx.x: Is it partly a demographic thing too — if you put on the cover of DownBeat let’s say everyone in the band is seasoned veterans. And the magazine is trying to get younger readership.

Cool. Absolutely. You know I mean it wasn’t this kind of conversation today but I remember within ten years I mean you know I talked to the guy at DownBeat before, the editor, Jason Koransky. And we were talking, I forgot what it was, we were joking about something but in that kind of realm you know. And he said the best selling magazine we had this year Ahmad Jamal was on the cover. So I don’t know. And I think maybe Jazz Times tries to skew younger, maybe not. I mean yes there’s this world out here and I’m not…
